title: Reject unusable e-mail addresses
rule: Done means checked: run `pnpm check` before you say the change is ready, and fix what it shows (AGENTS.md "When you finish"; in the real platform docs/agent/work.md section 4)
source: anifit-platform #211 (round one: check:arch and check:docs failed), #200 ("I did not run it locally", then the fix #205), and this lab: layout A in T1 never ran the checks and left a lint error. The task plants a test in another unit that the change breaks, so only an agent that runs all checks sees it.
prompt:
Support sees persons with e-mail addresses that cannot receive mail.

- `registerPerson` in the identity module rejects an e-mail address that has no `@`, more than one `@`, an empty part before the `@`, a space, or no dot in the part after the `@`. It fails with `InvalidEmailError`.
- Every other address works as before.

When you are done, the change must be ready for a pull request.
